mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM edu.learner_states WHERE attempt_id = #{attemptId})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO edu.learner_states (id, student_id, course_id, attempt_id, calculated_at) VALUES (#{state.id}, #{state.studentId}, #{state.courseId}, #{state.attemptId}, #{state.calculatedAt}) ON CONFLICT (attempt_id) DO NOTHING

INSERT INTO edu.learner_state_outcomes (learner_state_id, learning_outcome_id, probability, prediction_status) VALUES
(#{stateId}, #{outcome.learningOutcomeId}, #{outcome.probability}, #{outcome.status, javaType=edu.ai.lms.core.learnermodel.app.domain.LearnerStateOutcomeStatus, typeHandler=edu.ai.lms.core.learnermodel.adapter.out.persistence.mybatis.LearnerStateOutcomeStatusTypeHandler})
mapper.select: SELECT id, student_id, course_id, attempt_id, calculated_at FROM edu.learner_states WHERE student_id = #{studentId} AND course_id = #{courseId} ORDER BY calculated_at ASC, id ASC
SELECT id, student_id, course_id, attempt_id, calculated_at FROM edu.learner_states WHERE student_id = #{studentId} AND course_id = #{courseId} ORDER BY calculated_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT learning_outcome_id, probability, prediction_status FROM edu.learner_state_outcomes WHERE learner_state_id = #{stateId} ORDER BY learning_outcome_id ASC
